decisions.reason: Operator training builds directly on the firm's application know-how and established service offer, so the firm can interpret results and refine it easily.
A fourth rotary axis accessory extends the firm's core milling systems, where its in-house R&D and modular engineering let it learn from customer feedback.

Hybrid additive post-processing lies far from the firm's established knowledge base and was only mentioned on the website, so the firm has limited capacity to assimilate early results, and the resources are better redirected to its core business.
A high-speed CNC milling machine is the firm's core competence and was presented prominently, so related knowledge and R&D strongly support keeping it.
An automatic tool change system builds on the firm's machines and tooling expertise, and its dedicated page signals commitment that the firm's R&D can sustain.
